plan.notes: Source: official ASU Degree Search major map for 'Biological Sciences (Biology and Society), BS' (program code LABSCSBS), 2024-2025 catalog year: https://degrees.asu.edu/major-map/ASU00/LABSCSBS/null/ALL/2024 . Transcription method: automated parse of every term row (courses, credit hours, minimum grades) from the official major map page on 2026-09-30, spot-checked against the rendered page. Term names use ASU's own 'Term N' numbering. General Studies designations (HUAD, SOBE, SCIT, AMIT, GCSI, CIVI, SUST) are modeled as choice:true student-choice slots; OR-options are choice slots naming the alternatives. Per-course prerequisites are NOT listed on the ASU major map, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty. Campus: Tempe, Online, ASU Local. Major map track groups (Science in Global Society Courses, Major Biological Sciences Elective Courses, Philosophy of Science Courses, Bioethics Courses, Environmental Ethics, Conservation and Society Courses, History of Science Courses) are elective choice lists transcribed as choice slots with the group's courses as options.
